story: We opened The Break Room in the spring of 2022, in a storefront that had been a dry cleaner, a flower shop, and — at one strange point in the late 90s — a karaoke bar. The bones were good. The light was better.

We had two ideas, and they didn’t fit neatly together. The first was a quiet daytime cafe — the kind where you can think, where the music is low and the coffee is real. The second was a place that knew how to throw a party.

We tried to choose one. We couldn’t. So we did both, on different schedules, in the same room. By day, it’s a calm refuge. After 5 PM and on weekends, the lights warm up, the music gets louder, and the room becomes whatever you need it to be — birthday, baby shower, trivia night, board meeting in disguise.
We don’t think these two things are in conflict. The same care goes into a 7 AM cortado and a 9 PM toast. We just dress for the occasion.

values.title: Slow, then fast.
values.body: Mornings are slow on purpose. Evenings can be loud — also on purpose.

values.title: Sourced honestly.
values.body: We pay our roaster, baker, and farmers what their work is worth. It costs a little more. It’s worth it.

values.title: Good to staff.
values.body: Living wages, predictable schedules, real time off. The vibe starts here.

values.title: Welcoming by default.
values.body: Strollers, laptops, dogs at the door, parties of one. All of you.
